verdict.rationale: Formant is a SaaS fleet platform with AI features, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents a control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The 'where you choose, scoped research partnerships' line is not an AI-training control, and the configurable cloud-upload setting is an adjacent data-flow control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
